## Overview Restore Python-compatible nullable fields in Rust chat-completion streams. Fixes #63656. ## Claims - Preserve explicit nulls and the initial empty content delta in role, content, and terminal chunks. - Omit unset details on usage-only chunks and include reasoning details according to the configured reasoning parser. - Add HTTP regression coverage and document the behavior in the Chat API guide. ## Validation - Both regressions failed before the fix (exit 101): missing nullable stream fields and extra final-usage details. - Rust server tests: 511 passed (exit 0). - Workspace Clippy, all targets and features, with warnings denied: passed (exit 0). - Rust formatting, applicable pre-commit hooks, repository Markdown lint, and offline documentation links: passed (exit 0). Markdown lint ran directly with the installed local tool instead of its pre-commit hook. - Full workspace tests with all features: exit 101; 2,305 passed, 7 failed, 14 ignored. All 511 server tests passed in this run as well. Failures are in unchanged chat/audio/tokenizer code; four roundtrip failures and the generation-defaults failure reproduce on an isolated base revision. The base chat unit suite passes (427 tests), so the audio timing failure is intermittent or configuration-dependent. A Hugging Face cache-lock failure did not recur on the base run. The base generation-defaults check exits 101 with the same missing defaults. The full workspace command reported: ```text error: 3 targets failed: `-p vllm-chat --lib` `-p vllm-chat --test roundtrip` `-p vllm-text --lib` ``` Examples from those failures: ```text audio_pipeline_attributes_stage_timings_to_request: expected preprocess_audio_secs; actual timing keys omit it. roundtrip_kimi_k25: Error: stop token 163586 of "<|im_end|>" is not in the stop set {163585} roundtrip_step5: tokenizer error: the model config does not define `vocab_size` lower_text_request_uses_real_qwen_generation_defaults: expected default_temperature Some(0.6); actual None. ``` The same roundtrip tests also fail on base revision fe5fe8ba5fb9412ac6deafd192ae8b7c466b96c5: roundtrip_kimi_k25, roundtrip_mimo_v26, roundtrip_qwen3, and roundtrip_step5. No snapshots, skips, or thresholds were changed for these failures. - Python reference: exercised the checkout's Pydantic response classes for role, content, terminal, echo, continuous-usage, and final-usage cases. All four basic Rust SSE snapshot chunks match the serialized Python JSON. This checks response-model serialization, not a live Python engine run. The HTTP tests use the real router and chat pipeline with a scripted engine. The validation covers serialization, token-ID options, reasoning-parser configuration, SSE ordering, and error/DONE behavior. No model-quality, deployment, or performance claim is made. ```bash cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --locked -p vllm-server cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-features --locked --no-fail-fast -j 2 -- --quiet cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check ```
Before/after regression evidence With the new assertions on the base code, each command exited 101 with 0 passed and 1 failed: ```bash cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --locked -p vllm-server routes::tests::stream_chat_preserves_null_fields_by_chunk_kind -- --exact --nocapture cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --locked -p vllm-server routes::tests::include_usage_adds_final_usage_chunk_before_done -- --exact --nocapture ``` The first test observed: ```json {"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"role":"assistant"}}]} {"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"h"}}]} {"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"i"}}]} {"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]} ``` The final-usage assertion reported: ```text left: {"prompt_tokens":22,"total_tokens":25,"completion_tokens":3,"prompt_tokens_details":null,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0}} right: {"prompt_tokens":22,"completion_tokens":3,"total_tokens":25} ``` After the fix, both pass in the full server suite: ```text running 511 tests test result: ok. 511 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out ```
## Details The shared skip-None behavior omitted fields that Python explicitly sets to null. Usage serialization also retained null details on usage-only chunks and always included reasoning details. This follows the Rust frontend's documented Python parity contract. The current OpenAI schema permits nullable finish_reason; the fix does not depend on the issue's older claim that every chunk must contain that field. Use the existing serde, serde_json, and serde_with dependencies: nested Option values distinguish unset from explicitly null fields, while Serde attributes retain always-present nullable choice fields. A chat-stream usage DTO keeps the continuous and final usage rules separate from shared non-streaming Usage. No new dependency or custom serializer is needed. Author checklist notes: - **Design Fit:** Response DTOs own serialization. Reuse existing Serde attributes and usage types; isolate the conditional streaming rules. Engine, parser, and model-runner behavior is unchanged. - **Testing and Validation:** Deterministic in-process HTTP tests fail before and pass after the fix. The existing Rust Cargo CI job selects them through its rust/ dependency. Existing reasoning, tool, error, and token-metadata tests exercise shared paths. - **Code Quality and Style:** Preserve SPDX headers and repository formatting. Add user documentation under Chat API. A fresh agent found and quoted it locally; web and GitHub findability checks need the published PR branch and docs preview. - **Pull Request Contents:** Include the issue, root cause, tradeoffs, regression evidence, and validation limits. Duplicate checks found no open PR for #63656 or matching Rust streaming-null fixes at the start of implementation. The separate system_fingerprint value difference remains outside this issue. AI assistance was used; human review remains required before submission. ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [ ] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

files.patch:
@@ -174,6 +174,24 @@ see our [Multimodal Inputs](../../features/multimodal_inputs.md) guide for more
 
 Code example: [examples/basic/online_serving/openai_chat_completion_client.py](../../../examples/basic/online_serving/openai_chat_completion_client.py)
 
+#### Streaming responses
+
+Set `stream: true` on `/v1/chat/completions` to receive server-sent events.
+The Rust frontend follows the Python frontend's streaming JSON conventions:
+the first delta includes `role: "assistant"` and `content: ""`, and choices
+include `logprobs: null` and `finish_reason: null` until those values are
+available. The first chunk includes `prompt_token_ids` and `prompt_text` as
+`null` when they are unset. Other optional fields depend on the chunk type;
+for example, the terminal choice includes `stop_reason: null` when no stop
+token or stop string is reported.
+
+With `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}`, a final usage chunk has an
+empty `choices` array and omits unset usage details. In particular,
+`completion_tokens_details` is present when a reasoning parser is configured.
+With `continuous_usage_stats: true` in `stream_options`, earlier chunks also
+include usage; their `completion_tokens_details` is `null` when no reasoning
+parser is configured. The stream ends with `data: [DONE]`.
+
 #### Extra parameters
 
 The following [sampling parameters](../../api/README.md#inference-parameters) are supported.
